text_block_list.text:
One day, when I stopped by the cafeteria,
Marvelous Sunday called out to me—

text_block_list.name: Marvelous Sunday
text_block_list.text:
Look, look! A red yarn bag!
I knitted it myself! Isn't it Marvelous!
choice_data_list: Incredible, it turned out so cute.
Wow, it turned out so cute!

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
"It's an item I commissioned from the Knitting Circle.
It turned out so wonderfully that I almost feel
guilty receiving it for free."

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
Well, even though we call it a circle,
we're just gathering for our hobby, you know~.

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text:
Ufufu. If you ever need anything, Trainer,
please don't hesitate to ask.

text_block_list.name: Marvelous Sunday
text_block_list.text:
"I'll make it for you when that time comes!
I've made sooo many before, after all☆"

text_block_list.name: Marvelous Sunday
text_block_list.text: Curious after all!? Then I'll show you☆ Everyone, follow me!

text_block_list.name: Marvelous Sunday
text_block_list.text: "First up, the red cushions in the cafe! I knitted every single one of those covers myself☆"

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
The reason there were slightly more red cushions
was actually because of this, you see~.

text_block_list.name: Marvelous Sunday
text_block_list.text:
Right here are crocheted plushies to soothe Trainers!
A red puppy and a red kitty!

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text:
Fufu♪ You just have the kind of head
that makes people want to pet it~♪

text_block_list.name: Marvelous Sunday
text_block_list.text:
And is this the last of them?
The mesh bags for the soccer balls☆

And that makes ten spots... Tracen Academy was
practically covered in her knitted creations.
...Still, there was one thing bothering me.
choice_data_list: You only ever knit stuff in red, huh?
You only ever knit stuff in red, huh?

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
Come to think of it, you're right.
It almost feels like a deliberate obsession.

text_block_list.name: Marvelous Sunday
text_block_list.text:
Ehehe, yep!
Grandma taught me that!

text_block_list.name: Marvelous Sunday
text_block_list.text:
Both knitting and the color red...
are suuuper marvelous, she says! ☆★

text_block_list.name: Young Marvelous
text_block_list.text:
Waaaaah~~~n!
My knees are stinging so baaad~~~!

text_block_list.name: Marvelous's Grandmother
text_block_list.text:
My, oh my, I've already patched you up, though.
Well, in that case—

text_block_list.name: Marvelous's Grandmother
text_block_list.text:
There, the red ribbon is all done!
How is it? Red is a strong color, so putting it on will make the pain fly right away, right?

text_block_list.name: Young Marvelous
text_block_list.text:
Wah... it's true, it doesn't hurt...
The mesh is amazing! Red is so cool!
Yaaay☆

text_block_list.name: Marvelous's Grandmother
text_block_list.text:
Well now, running around with such a bright smile...
Hehe, with that, I can spot her right away.
Whether she's crying or smiling like that.

text_block_list.name: Marvelous Sunday
text_block_list.text:
That's why! Knitting, the color red, and this ribbon too...
are all precious Marvelous things!☆

The red ribbon suits the cheerful Marvelous Sunday perfectly.
Her grandmother must have thought so too when she gave it to her.
choice_data_list: That ribbon looks great on you!

text_block_list.name: Marvelous Sunday
text_block_list.text:
Huh?!
...Wait, wait, wait!!

text_block_list.name: Marvelous Sunday
text_block_list.text:
...Really?
Does it suit me? In what way?
choice_data_list: It suits your bright personality perfectly.
It suits your bright and cheerful personality perfectly.

text_block_list.name: Marvelous Sunday
text_block_list.text:
Ehehe, I see!
So it's a perfect match, huh~~~...☆

text_block_list.name: Marvelous Sunday
text_block_list.text:
Ehehe☆ Ehehe★
Ehehehehehehe☆★☆

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
"Well, well, you look so happy.
Seeing you like that makes me happy too~."

text_block_list.name: Marvelous Sunday
text_block_list.text: Because becoming marvelous enough to match this ribbon is one of my goals!

text_block_list.name: Marvelous Sunday
text_block_list.text:
It feels like I got praised
soooo much♪

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text: Fufu, I understand that feeling all too well.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text: My red glasses are a necessity, but at the same time, they're a sort of "talisman" for me.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
Having that validated feels like
having one's very existence validated.

text_block_list.name: Marvelous Sunday
text_block_list.text:
Yeah!
Having passion is simply Marvelous☆

text_block_list.name: Marvelous Sunday
text_block_list.text:
"Hey, wear something too, Trainer!
I'll knit it for you☆"
choice_data_list: I want to draw power from the red ribbon!
I'd like something I can use and cherish for a long time.

text_block_list.name: Marvelous Sunday
text_block_list.text:
To match with me?
...Did you really like it that much?

text_block_list.name: Marvelous Sunday
text_block_list.text:
Ehehe. In that case, I'll make you
a marvelous ribbon!

Later on, Marvelous Sunday attached
a red ribbon brooch to my bag.

text_block_list.name: Marvelous Sunday
text_block_list.text:
Yeah, yeah!
We want to shower it with love for a long, long time, after all!

text_block_list.name: Marvelous Sunday
text_block_list.text:
I'd recommend the pouch!
You can keep it safe in your bag, so it'll last a long time☆

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
Oh, how wonderful!
Would you mind making a portion for me as well, if it's no trouble?
Afterward, Marvelous Sunday completely lost track of time designing her red pouch!
